verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search domain names and check availability directly from a conversation, with no account or API credential required. A probe confirms the official docs page exists. The server's documented scope is narrow: only search and availability, while registration and DNS changes are handled through the separate gddy CLI agent skill. missing for 10: MCP tools beyond search/availability (registration, DNS, renewals), detailed connection/setup documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The GoDaddy MCP server lets AI assistants search for domain names and check domain availability directly from a conversation.
No GoDaddy account or API credential is required.
